column2: One last effort together! Elements rule, Clear: let's choose the right contacts to undo this protection without hurting the twins.
Break the bonds — Elements · Clear
The elemental bonds
The Twins of the Lake
Divine protection
Carrier
The crystals dissolve into bluish dust. The golden threads unravel and fade. The new twins are finally freed… but still sleep deeply.
The sleeping new twins
Their breathing is steady. Let's keep them warm.
I'll warn Kayla and Hilam immediately.
Without wasting a second, Kala takes out the communication mirror. Its surface lights up and reveals the faces of Kayla and Hilam.
We have the new twins. Their bonds are broken, but they won't wake up. We're at the pink lake.
Stay together. We're sending a carrier right away.
Ten seconds later, a portal unfurls on the shore. A carrier steps out and beckons them closer.
The carrier
Take the passage, quick! I can't hold it for long… This magic drains my strength.
Grimgors and Jhimm carefully pick up the twins. The group crosses the portal without waiting; Bolduc retrieves his axe before following his companions.
This time, our mission is truly accomplished. And I wouldn't say no to a good meal!
The adventurers finally leave the pink lake, delighted to have brought the new twins back safely. They can enjoy a little respite… End of chapter 1.
End chapter 1
The protection still holds. Let's start again calmly with the right elements.
Part 1: The Trial
The adventurers cross the portal and find themselves in the great hall of the Dassom palace. The new twins are still sleeping deeply.
The great hall of Dassom
Kayla awaits them beside Hilam. Her face is closed; despite their return, something seems to trouble her.
Myconide healers carefully take in the sleeping twins and carry them off to care for them.
The myconide healers
Come with us. The council awaits us in the meeting room.
They enter an immense, magnificent room. A council already sits there around a great table. As they arrive, conversations stop, then murmurs run through the assembly.
The council chamber
Trusting strangers for such an important and dangerous journey is heresy!
We chose these adventurers ourselves. They have our full trust. They completed the mission and brought the twins back safely.
We stand by our choice. Their courage and their deeds speak for them. They deserve our trust.
This decision wasn't yours alone, and not warning us was risky…
The Nahakins approach the group. These prophetic cat-men observe the adventurers in silence. One of them finally speaks.
The Nahakin
Hmm… I see no ill intent toward Dassom or its people… A little duel would help me see more clearly…
Show me your way of playing.
Accept the duel — Clear · Addition + Identical
The Nahakins
Elemental vials
Council chamber
The duel won, the Nahakin observes the adventurers one last time, then smiles softly.
They seem worthy to me…
End of part 1 of chapter 2: The Trial.
End part 1
Hmm… Another game would help me see more clearly.
Part 2: Sameron, Soryan and Zackarie
After the Nahakin's judgment, Jhimm tells the council everything the adventurers experienced: their encounter with Caleizis, the events at the pink lake… and the hydrelithes.
At this last word, a murmur runs through the assembly. The crowd stirs for a moment, then quickly calms.
We absolutely must discuss this. There are strange things in this story, but so be it…
Soryan seems to silently accept the Nahakins' words. The mood gradually eases in the room.
Two other people approach the adventurers: Zackarie and Sameron. They are still about ten meters from the group.
Without warning, Zackarie throws a needle. It grazes Bolduc's head and sticks into a pillar. Bolduc jumps in surprise!
Well, you don't look very brave…
Zackarie gives him a mischievous look. Kayla turns around immediately.
Oh, that's too much, Zack! You've only just met them!
And honestly, they're very brave, from what I've seen…
Kala then understands: Sameron had disguised himself as an old farmer! He is the one they met with Jordan, the dwarf horse.
The adventurers remember the old farmer's cabin and his strange little horse. So Sameron was already watching them during their journey…
Grimgors doesn't really appreciate discovering they were spied on without their knowledge.
Don't judge Soryan too quickly either. He can be a bit… harsh, sometimes.
Your quarters await you so you can rest. You may go freely into the city if you wish, but don't leave for now…
And why is that?
Your encounter with hydrelithes is… a bad sign. I'm afraid the rest of the council will take you for fugitives who have things to answer for after all…
We promise we'll come back to you as soon as we've taken stock with the council!
In the meantime…
Zackarie moves closer to Bolduc, still with that mischievous look.
I'm not a fan of dice duels, but with you, why not?
Zackarie hides her game well: play with the elemental bonuses to gain the advantage.
Face Zackarie — Dark · Elements
Bolduc wins the duel against Zackarie. End of part 2 of chapter 2: Sameron, Soryan and Zackarie.
Zackarie wins this round. Bolduc can retry the duel.
Part 3: An Eventful Night
The adventurers go to the quarters prepared for them. The rooms are very pretty and uncluttered: warm wood, bottle-green tones and everything needed for a good night's rest.
The adventurers' quarters
Bolduc and Jhimm share a room. After the day's events, the calm of the room finally seems to promise them some rest.
Bolduc and Jhimm's room
Grimgors and Kala settle into another room, just as pleasant. The last lights go out one by one.
Grimgors and Kala's room
Eberien shares the third room with Sir Broom. The palace quiets down; everyone eventually finds their place for the night.
Eberien and Sir Broom's room
Bolduc falls asleep. His mind slips into a dream bathed in softness…
In his dream, Bolduc meets Shauntéa, the goddess Mother Nature. She offers him her blessing.
Bolduc's dream
Chibi Bolduc receives Shauntéa's blessing in a dreamlike garden
With a slightly silly smile, Bolduc accepts by holding out a hand. In the room, his hand rises into the void…
Jhimm, for his part, is contacted by Heaum. The deity tries to speak to him, but her words reach him broken, almost incomprehensible.
Jhimm's dream
Chibi Jhimm tries to hear Heaum despite Caleizis's interference
Heaum
… North… over there…
Caleizis's laughter suddenly cuts through the dream. Jhimm understands: she is the one preventing Heaum from speaking as the deity wishes. He is left with only these scraps of words.
Grimgors meets Orcus in his dream. The demon provokes him and strives to sow doubt in the half-orc's thoughts.
Grimgors's dream
Orcus symbolically tears a shard of light from chibi Grimgors's chest
Orcus brings his hand to his chest and tears out a shard of light. Doubt creeps further into Grimgors's mind…
Kala relives her past as a soldier. Around her stretch war-ravaged lands. The images of this past lock her in a nightmare.
Memory • Kala's dream
Then the vision begins to fade. A warm voice is heard.
Kala's dream
A warm voice
Stop, that's enough.
The nightmare turns into a dream. Kala sees herself with the other adventurers: they fight together, proudly, united in the same momentum.
Kala's nightmare dissipates and the chibi adventurers fight proudly together
Finally, Eberien is contacted by Caleizis. She shows him his abandoned village again: the same silent houses, the same absence…
Eberien's dream
Caleizis joins chibi Eberien in the vision of his abandoned village
At the end of this vision, Caleizis even slips a hand into his wizard's robe. She leaves a memory there before the dream fades.
Upon waking, Eberien puts a hand under his robe. A magic scroll has appeared there… The memory left by Caleizis did not vanish with the dream.
End of part 3 of chapter 2: An Eventful Night.
Part 4: Visiting Dassom
At dawn, the adventurers meet up and confide in each other about what they saw and felt during the night.
Bolduc's blessing, Heaum's interrupted words, Grimgors's and Kala's visions, Eberien's scroll… Each shares their experience with the others.
They decide to go out and visit Dassom and spend a little of the money received for the success of their mission. Kayla and Hilam entrusted them with lovely pouches as a reward.
The adventurers reach the merchant quarter. The stalls overflow with products each more interesting than the last.
The merchant quarter
Potions, fabrics, curious objects and travel gear catch their eyes. The group takes the time to gawk at all these wonders.
Among the stalls, Kala runs into Velmarys. Happy to see an old comrade again, he stops beside Velmarys.
Kala! What a pleasure to see you again. We could talk this evening, when you're a bit freer.
Velmarys is about to leave when a crash interrupts the visit.
A clearly untalented magician has just been crushed by his own creation: a stone golem!
A clumsy magician gets crushed by his own stone golem, chibi style
The heavy stone creature threatens passersby and stalls. The adventurers step in to stop it.
The stone golem is massive: its earth dice hit hard on this terrain.
Face the golem — Dark · Addition
The stone golem
Stone golem
The golem is destroyed. Guards arrive as reinforcements to help tidy the stalls, clear the debris and tend to the passersby.
The golem is destroyed; chibi guards clear the market and heal the passersby
The merchant quarter gradually regains its calm. The adventurers can resume their visit of Dassom.
They continue on to the hunters' quarter to find the Golden Griffon tavern.
The hunters' quarter
End of part 4 of chapter 2: Visiting Dassom.
The golem still threatens the merchant quarter. The adventurers must retry the duel to stop it.
Part 5: Maebril and the Fairy Mist Quarter
The adventurers enter the Golden Griffon tavern. They greet Maebril, who warmly returns their hello.
The Golden Griffon tavern
Hello to you! Welcome to the Golden Griffon.
The group looks at the bounty board. Not a quest, not a notice… It looks quite empty to them.
You have to earn it to be able to read the board.
The bounty board only shows quests to guild members. For adventurers, its surface stays entirely blank.
Before giving you quests, could you go to the myconide quarter? They have a small problem… You can get there through the mist quarter or the noble quarter.
The adventurers choose to go through the fairy mist quarter. A soft colorful mist envelops the streets as they arrive.
The fairy mist quarter
No sooner have they entered than pixies cast charms on them. Lights swirl around them… and Bolduc disappears!
Another pixie
The little pixie
Exasperated, Kala just manages to catch a small pixie before it escapes.
Chibi Kala catches a small crying pixie in the fairy mist
What did you do with my friend! Where is he?!
It was just for fun…
Send us with him too.
All right, but can we play a bit first? I promise your friend is fine.
Irritated, Kala accepts the duel to find Bolduc.
The pixie plays with her most mischievous dice, and elemental bonuses count in every fight.
Challenge the pixie — Clear · Addition · Identical · Elements
The pixie
Mischievous pixies
The Fairy Pachié
Velcan
A second after the duel, a burst of rainbow glitter sweeps the adventurers away.
They find themselves in the myconide quarter: a plant-filled place underground, covered in greenery and white mushroom houses.
The myconide quarter
Bolduc is indeed there. He waits calmly in the company of a silent myconide.
Chibi Bolduc waits calmly beside a silent myconide, in front of the white mushroom houses of the underground quarter
End of part 5 of chapter 2: Maebril and the Fairy Mist Quarter.
Another game? Your friend is fine, I promise!
The adventurers find Bolduc with the myconides. Without any mouth opening, a voice resonates in their minds: the inhabitants communicate by telepathy.
The myconides
Several of our own ventured into the surrounding caverns. We have lost contact with them…
Other adventurers have already left to look for them. They haven't come back either.
The adventurers immediately set off to the rescue, determined to find the missing and discover the source of the evil.
In the damp caverns, every step demands caution. Living vines stretch across their path; mushrooms release soporific spores.
The damp caverns
The group spots the natural traps in time. The adventurers step over the vines and avoid the spore clouds without being caught off guard.
Further on, strange larvae wriggle between the rocks. They suddenly rush at the adventurers!
The larvae try to latch onto the adventurers. The group prepares to repel them.
Face the larvae
The larvae
Fickle larvae
Giant worm
Some adventurers get bitten. The larvae try to take possession of their bodies, but the group manages to tear them off and get rid of the creatures.
While searching the surroundings, the adventurers discover a precious relic: a bottomless bag!
This magic bag can hold great quantities of gear, gold and objects. A very useful find for the rest of their journey.
The group resumes its exploration. But magic vines burst from the cave ceiling and fall upon the adventurers!
Jhimm has no time to dodge them. The vines wrap around him and bind him, leaving him immobilized while his companions fight.
If someone could free me… now would be the time!
Grimgors rushes to his aid. He cuts the vines imprisoning Jhimm and frees him, while the others drive off the last living plants.
Jhimm finally regains his freedom. The group gathers: their missing companions remain to be found, and the source of the evil remains unknown.
End of part 6 of chapter 2: Lost Companions.
The creatures still prevent the group from progressing. The adventurers must retry the duel to drive them off.
